action.sql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debit - credit),0) FROM gl_lines WHERE entity_id='US01' AND period='2026-03' AND account_id='6400' AND dept_id='MKT') AS actual, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM budgets WHERE entity_id='US01' AND period='2026-03' AND account_id='6400' AND dept_id='MKT') AS budget, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debit - credit),0) FROM gl_lines WHERE entity_id='US01' AND period='2026-03' AND account_id='6400' AND dept_id='MKT') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM budgets WHERE entity_id='US01' AND period='2026-03' AND account_id='6400' AND dept_id='MKT') AS variance
